headline: The FV trigger tracks ~1/3 of network depth for MHA models (peak_layer ≈ 0.30·L, peak-fraction 0.315±0.05 across three families and 2021→2025 — confirming the paper's |L|/3), but the MHA→GQA shift moves the trigger to ~0.6·L in the Qwen family, so a single depth rule collapses across the full ladder (α=0.02, R²=0.00); the FV effect itself holds high (45–92%) with no monotone era trend.

metrics.note: confirmed for GPT-J, NeoX, Llama-2, OLMo-2 across 3 families

metrics.note: ~10-head plateau holds for MHA; GQA needs proportionally ~2.5× more (0.84–0.89 of all heads)

tables.title: Era ladder — derived quantities (all traced to 001 / replication artifacts)

figures.caption: Headline fit. Peak FV edit layer vs model depth L. MHA models (circles) hug the paper's L/3 line (solid = MHA through-origin fit α=0.30); the GQA Qwen models (squares) sit far above at ~0.6·L, so a single-slope fit over all six rungs collapses (α=0.02, R²=0.00). Color = family.
figures.alt: Scatter of peak layer vs depth; four MHA points on the L/3 line near layer 8-12, two GQA Qwen points high at 18-20.

figures.caption: Effect size vs era. Mean top-1 zero-shot FV accuracy at each model's peak edit layer vs release year (GPT-NeoX antonym-only). FV stays high (45–92%) far above a near-zero no-FV baseline; the era trend is flat (+1.0%/yr, R²=0.01) — the effect holds rather than strengthening or decaying. Color = family, ○=MHA, ■=GQA.
figures.alt: FV accuracy points spread 45-92% across 2021-2025 with a nearly flat trend line, baseline near zero.

figures.caption: Localization vs architecture. Left: fraction of top-AIE heads in the first ⅔ of layers stays high across families (MHA 0.93 vs GQA 0.81). Right: mean layer-fraction of the top-K heads is deeper for GQA (0.62 vs MHA 0.47). The signature is preserved; GQA sits deeper and Qwen2.5 is the most diffuse.
figures.alt: Two bar charts: head concentration in first two-thirds of layers, and mean layer-fraction, grouped by MHA vs GQA.

notes: 0 GPU-h: pure re-analysis of 001's on-disk artifacts + replication anchors. Every number traced to a 001/replication file (see followup_summary comparison_to_original and results/derived_master.json prov fields).
No instruct rung: 001's Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct was gated/skipped, so the base-vs-instruct confound named in the instruction could NOT be tested. All rungs are base models.

GPT-NeoX is antonym-only (single task, inherited from 001): no concentration/induction/#heads data. Qwen3 country-capital FV failed entirely; its effective peak (0.542) excludes that task's spurious layer-0 peak.

Low R² on the MHA peak_layer~α·L fit is a depth-range artifact (MHA L spans only 28-44); the robust statement is the tight peak-fraction cluster 0.315±0.05 ≈ L/3, visible as MHA points hugging the L/3 line.

n=6 rungs, single seed; new models bf16, anchors fp16 (inherited from 001). Scale/era trends have wide CIs (p≈0.4-0.9) — reported as 'holds/no monotone trend', not precise slopes. Induction ratio = top-K prefix-match / all-head mean; >1 = enriched.
GPT-J anchor cross-checked from the replication disk (per-seed argmax then mean = 65.87% ≈ 001's 65.9%, peak_frac 0.361 exact) before being reused.
